description: cited_commit_missing: a backticked 7-40 character lowercase hex token with at least one letter that no known repository holds as a commit is listed; an all-digit token (a token count), uppercase hex and a token under 7 characters are not commit-shaped. A present commit, also one held only by a second known repository, is checked by unit anchors-commit. The flag is an input, not a trigger: memory_pass stays null at quiet_sweeps 2; the project's index counts its suspects.

entries.heading: All-digit token is not a commit
Uppercase or short hex is not a commit
